strongest_angle: Examining the October 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis published in the Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies regarding lower-limb biomechanics in plantar fasciitis patients.

key_facts.fact: The systematic review and meta-analysis published in the Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies evaluates lower-limb biomechanical alterations in patients with plantar fasciitis during walking and running.
Researcher Glaucia Bordignon and colleagues authored the study on multi-segment foot motion and kinetic forces in individuals with plantar fasciitis published in October 2026.
key_facts.source_name: Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies

key_facts.fact: A previous study by Ryan Chang and colleagues investigated multi-segment foot kinematics and ground reaction forces during the gait of individuals with plantar fasciitis.
The study published in the Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies and indexed by Elsevier covers both male and female participants numbering 294 subjects.
